name: Crosstown Plaza
summary: Crosstown Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center serving Schenectady residents with convenient retail and services along Watt Street. With strong community ratings and accessible hours, it provides a practical shopping destination for everyday needs in the Capital Region.
demographics: Crosstown Plaza serves the diverse Schenectady community, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area draws from both the immediate Mont Pleasant neighborhood and broader Capital Region shoppers seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services. Typical visitors include value-conscious households balancing quality and affordability, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and senior residents who appreciate the accessible location along Watt Street.
description: Crosstown Plaza stands as a convenient neighborhood shopping destination in Schenectady, New York, strategically located at 2330 Watt Street in the heart of the city's retail corridor. This community-oriented center has served local residents for decades, providing essential retail services and everyday shopping needs to the surrounding neighborhoods. The plaza maintains consistent operating hours from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, making it accessible for both daytime shoppers and those stopping by after work. With a solid 4.1-star rating from over 1,400 Google reviews, Crosstown Plaza has earned its reputation as a reliable shopping option for Schenectady residents. The center's location offers easy access from major thoroughfares, making it a practical choice for quick errands and routine shopping trips in the Capital Region.
